title: Le Coup de Foudre
kind: Queer short film · Melodrama · Psychological horror
lead: Two women, one apartment and a sudden, overwhelming attraction. A stylised queer love story between melodrama and horror.
text: Le Coup de Foudre explores the fleeting intensity of love at first sight and the darker emotions that follow. Without conventional dialogue, slow-motion imagery and an unsettling soundtrack carry the story as desire turns into obsession, jealousy and loss.
The film and an accompanying photographic series were shown at PH0N0L0GUES, a feminist exhibition in Berlin on heartbreak and the five stages of grief (14 February 2023).

credits.name: Raviva Nsiama · Moana Marie Schorlemer · Pauline Pyras
